answer: A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The mesa schedule is applied in signal and mirror publishes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3957 identities would post 3010 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
